name: Karunguruvai Rice

description:
Karunguruvai Rice is a traditional medicinal rice variety from Tamil Nadu, widely known for its powerful health benefits and natural nutrition. Used in Siddha medicine and traditional cooking, it is known for its low glycemic index and high fiber content.

Karunguruvai rice is also widely used in preparing Karunguruvai rice kanji, which is considered highly beneficial for health. Choosing a quality source ensures better taste and nutritional value.
howToUse:
Soak rice for 6–8 hours before cooking for best results.
Use 1:2.5 ratio of rice to water for perfect texture.
Ideal for Karunguruvai rice kanji (porridge) — very popular for health.
Suitable for daily meals, sambar rice and traditional recipes.
Can be used in Karunguruvai rice recipe in Tamil for authentic cooking.

name: Karuppu Kavuni (Black Kavuni Rice)
tagline: Traditional black rice rich in antioxidants, fiber & nutrients — 100% natural and chemical-free.
description:
Karuppu Kavuni Rice is a traditional black rice variety known for its rich nutritional value and health benefits. Sourced naturally and processed without chemicals, it is widely used in South Indian households for its medicinal properties.

This rice is rich in iron, fiber, and antioxidants, making it a healthy choice for daily consumption. It is especially beneficial for improving immunity and overall well-being.

Nansei Organics brings you high-quality Karuppu Kavuni Rice that is clean, natural, and farm-sourced.
howToUse:
Soak Karuppu Kavuni rice overnight (8–10 hours) for best results.
Use 1:3 ratio of rice to water — it needs more water than regular rice.
Pressure cook for 4–5 whistles or cook on low flame for 35–40 minutes.
Ideal for Kavuni Arisi Payasam — soak overnight, cook with coconut milk and jaggery.
Can be used for daily meals, kanji (porridge) and traditional sweet recipes.
Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place.

name: Arubatham Kuruvai Rice

description: Arubatham Kuruvai is a 60-day short-duration traditional rice variety from Tamil Nadu. Known for its light texture and easy digestibility, it is ideal for everyday cooking and is especially recommended for the elderly and children.
howToUse:
Rinse rice 2–3 times before cooking.
Use 1:2 ratio of rice to water — cooks faster than other heritage varieties.
Cook on medium heat for 15–20 minutes (60-day rice cooks quickly).
Suitable for daily meals — rice, sambar, rasam and curd rice.
Ideal for kanji (porridge) — especially good for elderly and children.
Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place.

If you are looking to buy Poongar Rice online, Nansei Organics provides high-quality, chemical-free rice that maintains its authentic taste and quality.

name: Mappillai Samba (Mani Samba) Rice
tagline: The bridegroom's rice — legendary strength-giving heritage variety.
description: Mappillai Samba, literally meaning 'bridegroom's rice', is a legendary Tamil Nadu heritage variety known for its strength-giving properties. Traditionally fed to bridegrooms before weddings, it is rich in iron, fiber and natural compounds that boost stamina and vitality.
howToUse:
Soak Mappillai Samba rice for 1 hour before cooking.
Use 1:2.5 ratio of rice to water.
Cook on medium-low heat for 30–35 minutes.
Pairs beautifully with coconut milk curries and traditional gravies.
Excellent as a simple pulao with ginger and turmeric.
Can be used for kanji (porridge) for maximum health benefits.

The natural floral aroma is best preserved when cooked in an open pot.

name: Vellai Kavuni (White Kavuni Rice)

White Kavuni Rice is a traditional South Indian rice variety known for its soft texture, mild taste, and natural nutritional value. White Kavuni rice is widely used in daily cooking and is considered a healthier alternative to polished white rice.

Perfect for sweet pongal — cook with moong dal, jaggery and ghee.
Ideal for payasam (rice pudding) with coconut milk and cardamom.
Can be used for daily meals and traditional celebration dishes.

name: Paneer Rose (Fragrant Rose)
tagline: Fragrant rose petals widely used for rose water, skin care, hair care and traditional herbal wellness.
description:
Panneer Rose, also known as fragrant rose flower, is widely used in traditional Indian households for its natural aroma and health benefits. Panneer rose in English refers to a variety of rose known for its strong fragrance and use in rose water, skincare, and herbal preparations.

Panneer rose petals are commonly used to prepare panneer rose water, which is popular for face care and cooling drinks. Many people search for panneer rose benefits because it supports skin health, hair care, and overall wellness.

If you are looking to buy panneer rose online, dried panneer rose petals and panneer rose powder are widely used for natural beauty and herbal uses.
howToUse:
Boil 10–15 dried petals in 500ml water for 5 minutes to make rose water.
Use rose water as a face toner — apply with cotton pad morning and night.
Add petals to warm bath water for a relaxing aromatic soak.
Prepare rose milk by soaking petals in warm milk with sugar.
Use dried petals in face packs mixed with sandalwood powder and rose water.
Store prepared rose water in the refrigerator for up to 7 days.

name: Hibiscus Flower
tagline: Dried hibiscus flowers for herbal tea, hair care, skin care and natural home remedies.
description:
Hibiscus dried flowers are widely used in herbal drinks, skincare, and traditional remedies. Known as Hibiscus sabdariffa, these flowers are popular for making hibiscus tea, which is valued for its refreshing taste and health benefits.

Many people search for hibiscus tea benefits because it supports heart health, skin glow, and overall wellness. Hibiscus flowers are also used in powder form for hair care and face packs. Dried hibiscus flowers are easy to use and can be prepared as tea or natural remedies at home.

If you are looking for hibiscus dried flowers for tea or hibiscus powder for hair and skin, choosing high-quality dried flowers ensures better results.
howToUse:
Boil 5–10 dried hibiscus flowers in 300ml water for 5 minutes to make hibiscus tea.
Strain and add honey or jaggery to taste. Serve hot or cold.
For hair mask: grind dried flowers into powder, mix with coconut oil, apply to scalp for 30 minutes.
For face pack: mix hibiscus powder with yogurt and apply for 15 minutes.
Prepare hibiscus sherbet by boiling flowers with sugar and cooling spices.
Store dried flowers in an airtight container away from moisture.

name: Aavaram Flower
tagline: Traditional Tanner's Cassia flower — cooling herbal tea, skin care and Ayurvedic wellness from Tamil Nadu.
description:
Avarampoo, also known as Avaram Poo, is a traditional herbal flower widely used in Tamil Nadu for its natural health and skincare benefits. Avaram poo in English is commonly known as Tanner's Cassia flower, valued for its cooling and medicinal properties.

Many people search for Avarampoo benefits in Tamil because it helps manage body heat, supports digestion, and improves skin health. Avarampoo tea is especially popular for its natural cooling effect and is often used as a daily herbal drink.

Avarampoo powder and dried flowers are widely used for face packs, hair care, and traditional remedies. If you are looking to buy Avarampoo online, choosing quality dried flowers ensures better results.
howToUse:
Boil 5–10 dried Avarampoo flowers in 300ml water for 5–7 minutes.
Strain and drink as herbal tea — best consumed in the morning on an empty stomach.
For face pack: grind dried flowers into powder, mix with turmeric and rose water, apply for 15 minutes.
For hair care: mix Avarampoo powder with coconut oil and apply to scalp.
Can be combined with other herbs like neem or tulsi for enhanced benefits.
Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place.

name: Butterfly Pea Flower (Sangu Poo)

description:
Butterfly Pea Flower, also known as Sangu Poo in Tamil, is a traditional herbal flower widely used for tea, skincare, and natural remedies. Known for its vibrant blue color, butterfly pea flower tea is popular for its health benefits and refreshing taste.

Many people search for butterfly pea flower tea benefits because it helps improve memory, supports skin health, and provides a natural cooling effect. Butterfly pea flower is also used in powder form for face packs and hair care.

If you are looking to buy butterfly pea flower online, dried flowers and powder forms are widely used for herbal drinks and beauty routines. Lemon can be added to the tea to change its color from blue to purple.
howToUse:
Prepare butterfly pea flower tea by boiling 5–8 dried flowers in 250ml water for 3–5 minutes.
Add lemon juice to change the color from blue to purple — a natural pH reaction.
Use as natural food color in rice, drinks and desserts.
Apply as face pack in powder form mixed with rose water for skin glow.
Use in hair care routines — mix powder with coconut oil for scalp massage.
Suitable for herbal drinks, detox water and iced teas.

name: Organic Real Rose Milk
tagline: Pure rose milk mix — made from real Paneer Rose petals and natural sweeteners.
description: Our Organic Real Rose Milk mix is made from genuine Paneer Rose (Rosa damascena) petals, natural sugar and a touch of cardamom. No artificial colors, no synthetic rose essence — just the pure, authentic taste of real rose milk as it should be.
howToUse:
Mix 2 tablespoons of rose milk mix in 200ml cold milk.
Stir well until fully dissolved.
Add ice cubes and serve immediately for best taste.
Can also be served warm — mix in warm milk and stir.
Add a pinch of cardamom for extra flavor.
Store the mix in a cool, dry place away from moisture.

name: Hibiscus Sherbet
tagline: Traditional hibiscus sherbet mix — refreshing, tangy and naturally red.
description: Made from sun-dried Hibiscus sabdariffa flowers, natural sugar and a blend of cooling spices. This traditional sherbet mix makes a refreshing summer drink that is naturally rich in vitamin C and antioxidants. Just mix with cold water or milk.
howToUse:
Mix 2–3 tablespoons of sherbet mix in 200ml cold water.
Stir well until fully dissolved and serve over ice.
Can also be mixed with cold milk for a creamy version.
Add black salt and roasted cumin for a traditional taste.
Dilute more or less according to your taste preference.
Store the mix in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening.

name: Hand-pounded Rice Idiyappam Flour
tagline: Traditional hand-pounded rice flour — for soft, silky idiyappam.
description: Made from premium raw rice that is soaked, dried and hand-pounded using traditional methods. This idiyappam flour produces the softest, most silky string hoppers with a natural rice flavor that machine-milled flour cannot replicate.
howToUse:
Mix 1 cup flour with 1 cup boiling water and ½ tsp salt.
Mix immediately with a wooden spoon until a smooth dough forms.
Let rest for 5 minutes, then press through idiyappam press onto greased plates.
Steam for 8–10 minutes until firm and glossy.
Serve immediately with coconut milk, vegetable stew or chutney.
Store unused flour in an airtight container — use within 6 months.

name: Black Urad Dal Health Mix Powder
tagline: Protein-rich black urad dal health mix — for energy and strength.
description: A nutritious health mix made from roasted black urad dal (whole black gram) ground with traditional spices. Rich in protein, iron and B-vitamins, this mix can be consumed as a porridge, added to dosa batter or mixed with warm milk for a nutritious drink.
howToUse:
Mix 3 tablespoons of health mix powder in 200ml warm milk or water.
Add jaggery or honey and a pinch of cardamom to taste.
Stir well and serve immediately as a morning porridge.
Can be added to dosa or idli batter for extra nutrition.
Blend into smoothies or milkshakes for a protein boost.
Optional: add 1 tsp ghee for extra flavor and nutrition.

name: Country Fig Powder
tagline: Sun-dried country fig powder — a natural digestive and energy tonic.
description: Made from sun-dried country figs (Ficus carica) ground into a fine powder. Country figs are known for their exceptional fiber content, natural digestive enzymes and high iron content. Used as a natural remedy for constipation, anemia and as an energy supplement.
howToUse:
Morning tonic: mix 1 tsp in warm water with lemon and honey.
Smoothie boost: add 2 tsp to any fruit or vegetable smoothie.
Porridge: stir into oats or ragi porridge for added fiber.
Energy balls: mix with dates, nuts and coconut to form energy balls.
Can be added to milkshakes, yogurt or desserts.
Start with 1 tsp daily and gradually increase to 2 tsp for best results.
